submission.justification:
Mixture-G1 at 2.0 mm gives the best simulated time resolution of the three candidates (0.897 ns). It is the best of the 15 gap/mixture points, and the prior 2 mm simulation agrees (0.9 ns). The 2.0 mm gap is also near the flat minimum of the G1 curve: 1.5 mm gives 0.943 ns, 2.5 mm gives 0.921 ns, and 3.0 mm degrades to 1.135 ns. G2 (1.309 ns at 2 mm) and G3 (1.967 ns at 2 mm) are clearly worse.

The GWP100 hard requirement is NOT verified for any candidate. gwp100_verified_count = 0, and no candidate_specs.md values were recorded in the results, so I cannot confirm that G1 has GWP100 <= 150. This recommendation is therefore conditional: G1 at 2.0 mm should be adopted only after its GWP100 is confirmed to be at or below 150 from candidate_specs.md. If G1 fails that check, the next choice on time resolution would be G2 at 2.0 mm, which is also unverified for GWP. Note also that the recorded results include no GWP values, so the ranking above is based only on time resolution.

Recommended gap is 2.0 mm, within the 1-3 mm range.
G1 at 2.0 mm gives 0.897 ns, the lowest time resolution among all simulated mixture/gap combinations (G2 best 1.309 ns, G3 best 1.967 ns).
